title: Elina Pilates Bean Bag Roll-up Device
overviewParagraph: The Bean Bag Roll-up Device strengthens arm, wrist, and forearm mobility by having you hold the bar at shoulder height and roll/unroll the rope for controlled resistance. Designed to support tennis elbow (lateral epicondylitis) therapy, it helps improve circulation while building strength and endurance in the forearms. The weighted bag-and-rope design lets you customize difficulty by adding or removing weight and adjusting how far the bar is held from your shoulders. When the bag is emptied, it folds and rolls up compactly for easy storage and transport.
